subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF

E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO DECISION OF AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF
REPUBLIC OF IRELAND STIPULATING THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AND ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY ANY NATURAL
OR LEGAL PERSON FROM RUSSIAN FEDERATION, ALL AIR CARRIERS,
INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, POSSESSING OPERATING LICENCE(OL)
OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY RUSSIAN FEDERATION AUTHORITIES,
ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER/EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF REPUBLIC OF
IRELAND, AS PER AIP SUP 014/2026, AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN REPUBLIC OF
IRELAND AND ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY ANY NATURAL
OR LEGAL PERSON FROM REPUBLIC OF IRELAND, ALL AIR CARRIERS,
INCLUDING COMMERCIAL AIR CARRIERS, POSSESSING OPERATING LICENCE(OL)
OR ITS EQUIVALENT ISSUED BY AUTHORITIES OF REPUBLIC OF IRELAND
ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER/EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, EXCEPT ACFT IN
EMERGENCY, HUM FLT, SAN FLT, AND IN CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION
TO PERFORM FLT GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR MINISTRY
OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
